title: Flood: route the crew around closed roads
problem_line: The crew has to reach a stranded person while roads close above 0.3 m of water.

beats.caption: Water rises; the drone watches the stranded person at the creek road.
The crew's route is planned live from where they are, with the water depth at the time they would reach each road.
Each time the water updates the route is re-planned; roads above 0.3 m are closed.
The route proposed to a person keeps the crew out of deep water.

success_line: A route that stays under 0.3 m of water, re-planned as the water rose, approved by a person.
